name: model_stats
description: Global token usage statistics aggregated per provider/model: call count, prompt/completion/total tokens, cache hit rate, tokens/sec, and estimated USD cost. Useful for deciding which backend to use, spotting expensive runs, and planning context/token savings.
llm_description: Global per-provider/model token stats: call count, prompt/completion/total tokens, cache hit rate, tokens/sec, estimated USD cost. Pass {args: true} for a text table.

args.description: When present (any value), return a human-readable text table instead of structured JSON.
